name: Furoween
description: Furoween was a furry convention in Karlstad, Värmland, Sweden, and the country's third furry convention after FurryCon and NordicFuzzCon. It began as a furmeet, the idea of Jay TheCat and Manny Proudpaw, held in Gothenburg in 2013, 2014 and 2015, and moved to Karlstad with Jay TheCat, where it was held at the Hotel Savoy in 2016. In October 2017 it became a full furry convention. It was put on permanent hiatus in June 2018.
